sections.Profile:
The "St. Louis" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on February 18, 1949, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1949
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: America, Single Player, Women, Wood Rail, Cities, Original Theme

- Art: George Molentin
